content.value: . In an automatic traffic control system, car speeds arc monitored for over-speeded. Based on <sub>previous</sub> analysis, the probability of a car being over-speeded is 0.30. In a specific time frame. four cars arc investigated. Calculate the probabilities for the following scenarios:
i). Green light (no over speeded cars observed).
ii). Red light (all four cars are over speeded).
iii). Otherwise (mixed scenarios of over speeded and non-over speeded cars).
